description:
Radio FM – Internet Radio and Podcasts

Radio FM is a mobile application for listening to internet radio stations and podcasts from around the world. It provides access to a wide range of audio content, including music, news, talk shows, and entertainment programs.

You can browse and stream radio stations from different countries and explore podcasts across multiple categories and languages.

Content उपलब्ध (Available Content)

Radio stations from various countries and regions
Podcasts across categories such as news, music, talk shows, and entertainment
Multiple genres including classical, rock, pop, hip-hop, instrumental, and more

Key Features

Browse radio stations by country
Search for specific radio stations or podcasts
Save stations and podcasts to a favorites list
View recently played stations
Sleep timer to automatically stop playback
Alarm feature to start playback at a scheduled time
Access podcasts by category
Simple and easy-to-use interface
Playback controls from notifications
Option to start playback when the app opens

Device Support
Radio FM is compatible with Android Auto, Google Chromecast, Android TV, and wearable devices.

Radio Station Access
The app includes thousands of radio stations added by broadcasters worldwide. New stations may be added over time. If a station is not available, users can suggest it through the app.

Support and Feedback
For help or questions, visit: http://appradiofm.com/faq-list/

Contact: support@appRadioFM.com
